slides.title: Give a new habit *a moment to live in.*
slides.sub: What UCL research on habit formation found.

slides.title: A cue, then the action
slides.body: UCL researchers describe a habit as an action that becomes automatic with repetition: a cue in a situation gets linked to the behavior.

slides.title: Same context, every time
slides.body: Repeating it in the same context helped it become automatic. Missing one chance didn't significantly set people back. Being very inconsistent did.

slides.title: Slower than people expect
slides.body: On average it took 66 days, and some people took longer. Slow doesn't mean it isn't working.

slides.title: Pick the moment first.
slides.body: Choose one inner habit, like one honest sentence before you reply. Tie it to one moment: "When ___ happens, I will ___."
